dict.string: BRIR Convolver reads surround audio from its BRIR Convolver Surround device (or another loopback device you choose). macOS treats reading any audio input as microphone access; no microphone is used.

With head tracking turned on, BRIR Convolver uses your camera and Apple's Vision face tracking to see which way your head is turned, so the virtual speakers stay in place as you move. Video never leaves your Mac and isn't recorded.
BRIR Convolver captures system audio so it can apply your binaural room impulse response and play it back to your headphones.
